principle: Preserve Bees/Extra Bees gameplay concepts and visual readability while rebuilding implementation and assets for Minecraft Java 1.21.1.

concept_mapping.Forestry and Extra Bees frames: 19 ZeroG frame items; classic thin-frame silhouettes plus space-tier materials
concept_mapping.Scoop and apiary hand tools: nine vanilla-handheld tools with exact 16x diagram silhouettes and Blockbench player grip previews
concept_mapping.Apiarist Database and analysis tools: Portable Beealyzer and Habitat Locator gadget family; flat readable device sprites
concept_mapping.Genetics serums and analysis: Serum Vial, Trait Serum, Genetic Splicer and Geno Station
concept_mapping.Extra Bees combs, drops and products: space combs, pollen, honey, royal/cosmic jelly and material outputs
concept_mapping.Alveary upgrade components: tiered functional blocks and seven ZeroG multiblock apiary assemblies
concept_mapping.Scented/apiarist protection gear: standard and cosmic Apiarist armor on canonical 1.21.1 humanoid bones
concept_mapping.Bee species: deferred to the agreed later pass using vanilla Bedrock bee proportions, eyes and wings with ZeroG textures/effects

compatibility_rule: Old 1.12 Java code is reference material only; registries, renderers, item models, data assets and animations must use the 1.21.1 project conventions.
